note: Answer key for test/accuracy-proof.mjs, written before the first run. expect: regexes (case-insensitive) that must ALL match the visible answer. trap: the real-world value; if it matches and expect does not, the answer came from memory (trap-failed). invent: an outside answer to the part the book lacks. correction: a false-premise answer that corrects the premise from the book. ack: the answer must say the rest is missing. cite: the label(s) where the fact lives. support: text that must be on a cited page for that citation to count as correct.
